newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shui On considers property division spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Shui On considers property division spinoff.

text.p: Shui On Holdings Ltd will consider a separate listing of its property division in the near future, group chairman Vincent Lo said on Tuesday.

"We are considering a listing of our property division and we will work on it in the next few months for the details," Lo told reporters after a press briefing on the listing of Shui On group unit Shui On Construction and Materials Ltd.
Lo said the property division had big investments in China and the size of the division was much bigger than the construction and construction materials division.
"I think it is better to seek a listing for the property division after it posts some solid track record in later days," Lo said. He declined to comment on when the spinoff will take place.

Shui On Construction and Materials said earlier on Tuesday it planned to offer 65 million shares at HK$9.30 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong. In the offer, 48.75 million shares will be placed to professional investors in Asia and Europe and the remaining 16.25 million shares will for public subscription in Hong Kong.
